I’ve looped in Neha (security/compliance SME) and Ben (solutions engineering) for any technical follow-ups.

Rishi —

Appreciate the recap and attachments. Quick answers and context from our side: 

SOC 2: In progress. We completed a Type I in 2025 with Crowe and are targeting Type II for 2027 Q1. We can share the Type I report but Type II will be subject to the audit timeline.

HIPAA/GDPR: Stonewell is a covered entity for certain product lines and requires BAAs for PHI processing. For GDPR, our DPO has standard SCC requirements — can provide the specific clause wording you use.

Incident Response / Breach Notification: We require customer-facing breach notification commitments in contracts (72-hour detection/35-day public notice windows are typical asks from our legal). For vendor intake, we first collect IR timeline templates and evidence of DR tests (latest tabletop / full failover date).

I attached the partially completed vendor questionnaire (first pass) and our security intake form. A few open items for Redwood:
- Please confirm if Redwood supports on-prem key management (HSM/KMS integration) or if keys are exclusively managed by Redwood in hosted mode.
- Can you provide your most recent DR exercise date and summary (scope, RTO/RPO targets achieved)?

We’ll aim to return a completed vendor questionnaire by 2026-10-16. If you can provide the IR timeline and a short summary of DR exercises, that would help us prioritize procurement items.

Thanks — Amira
Amira Khan
